questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L_PO_LO_OK_OP_KL_POK

options.text: O, K, P, L, O, O
O, P, O, K, O, L
O, P, K, O, L, O
O, O, P, K, L, O

questions.solution:
Given :- L_PO_LO_OK_OP_KL_POK

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) O, K, P, L, O, O → L **O** P O **K** - L O **P** O K - **L** O P **O** K - L **O** P O K

 
• Here, **"LOPOK"** is repeated.

2) O, P, O, K, O, L → L **O** P O **P** - L O **O** O K - **K** O P **O** K - L **L** P O K

3) O, P, K, O, L, O → L **O** P O **P** - L O **K** O K - **O** O P **L** K - L **O** P O K

4) O, O, P, K, L, O → L **O** P O **O** - L O **P** O K - **K** O P **L** K - L **O** P O K​

 
• Option (1) gives the pattern of :- L O P O K - L O P O K - L O P O K - L O P O K

Hence, the correct answer is **"O, K, P, L, O, O".**

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'SOBER' is coded as '64' and 'NOSTALGIA' is coded as '107'. How will 'REPAIR' be coded in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

Sum of alphabet positional values of given word + Number of letters in given word.

'SOBER' is coded as '64'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/611b9d0ace3ad6fbc9fbada888865b15ff7b023c6765dfb1a5c4fc1e594dfb6e.png] 

Sum of alphabet positional value of the word = 19 + 15 + 2 + 5 + 18 = 59

Number of letter = 5

= 59 + 5

= 64

And

'NOSTALGIA' is coded as '107'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee2bf3a102a666ab2773877146c6b4354f1f85cdd128e6894097e2544138425d.png] 

Sum of alphabet positional value of the word = 14 + 15 + 19 + 20 + 1 + 12 + 7 + 9 + 1 = 98

Number of letter = 9

= 98 + 9

= 107

Similarly,

'REPAIR' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2dccf251f3bd695072d016408b86c5b5091f145e38cecbbb7ecc5a687997a24f.png] 

**Sum of alphabet positional value of the word = 18 + 5 + 16 + 1 + 9 + 18 = 67**

**Number of letter = 6**

**= 67 + 6**

**= 73**

Hence, the correct answer is **"73".**

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number. 

129 : 216 :: 165 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Second number - First number = 87**

**Similarly,**

**Fourth number - Third number = 87**

 
• 129 : 216 → 216 - 129 = 87

Similarly,

 
• **165 : ? → X - 165 = 87 → X = 165 + 87 = 252**

Hence, the correct answer is **"252".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All guavas are pears.

Some kiwis are pears.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some kiwis are guavas.

II. Some pears are kiwis.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd80e4856f486218cf6751bb184fc90fa893bd45ec2f12109e1abf0edaeb5c5d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some kiwis are guavas → False (As Some kiwis are pears so, Some kiwis are guavas is false)

II. Some pears are kiwis → True (As Some kiwis are pears so, Some pears are kiwis is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
